projectDescription: A React + Vite demo application built for a Spanish-language web development bootcamp that demonstrates frontend authentication and authorization patterns including JWT login/registration, protected routes, and localStorage token management.
keyFeatures: JWT-based user authentication with login and registration flows
Protected routes using a reusable ProtectedRoute component
localStorage-based token persistence across page reloads
Anonymous route guards that redirect authenticated users away from login/register
React Router v6 navigation with programmatic redirects
User profile display with data fetched from a REST API
Modular utility functions for auth and API interactions
publicApiSurface: ProtectedRoute({ isLoggedIn, children, anonymous }) — route guard component
App handleLogin({ username, password }) — login handler
App handleRegistration({ username, email, password, confirmPassword }) — registration handler
